set.body:
Objective

Replace unconditional cross-Gram symmetrization with one ordered outer-product primitive and route the existing self-geometry path through it.

Primary ownership

R/task.R, R/kernel.R, R/compiler.R, memory accounting touched by the raw bilinear lowering, and focused tests.

Deliverables

- Feature tasks form b_left times transpose(b_right) without implicit symmetrization.
- Complete rectangular forms use q_left*q_right coordinates; proven symmetric self-forms may use packed coordinates.
- Direct pair queries calculate b_left^T H b_right before spatial contraction.
- Existing self-adjoint cross-partition estimation is an explicit specialization/fusion of ordered edges.
- Old cross-Gram code is removed only after differential equivalence.

Acceptance

Rectangular complete forms match an independent dense-loop oracle; transpose and direct-sum laws pass; direct and late queries agree; old/new self-geometry results agree over dense/sparse frames, block sizes, memory/block storage, and partition order; feature blocks are read once per required partition; memory plans remain conservative.

Non-goals

No covariance, correlation, Fisher, pair-GLM constructors, or general bridge.
set.title: Implement the unsymmetrized effect-form kernel and self specialization
